_: Copy this to voice.json to change how Pinnacle sounds. voice.json is gitignored because it holds a key.
_edge: The default. Free, no key, nothing leaves the machine. Edge exposes Microsoft's online neural voices; Chrome here does not.
_elevenlabs: The best of the three, and the only one that costs money past its free tier. provider: elevenlabs, then paste your own key. It stays on the server and never reaches the browser or git.
_responsive: responsivevoice.org. Free for personal use only, and it is a third party script that gets sent every word she says.
